guides.title: Written guides
guides.description: Follow the steps one by one to learn how to use ZENITH.

sell.title: Make a sale
sell.description: From opening the register to printing the receipt.
steps: Open the Billing / Cashier menu.
Search for a product by name, CIP or barcode (F2).
Adjust quantities with + / - keys or the * shortcut.
Select the customer if needed (F4).
Click Checkout (F9) and choose the payment method.
The receipt prints automatically if the printer is configured.

ticket.title: Print a thermal receipt
ticket.description: Set up and use an ESC/POS thermal printer with QZ Tray.
steps: Install and launch QZ Tray on the workstation (green icon near the clock).
In Settings > Printing, click Detect.
Select your POS-80 thermal printer.
Check Open cash drawer if you have one.
Allow QZ Tray to remember this site on the first popup.
Print a receipt: the preview is no longer needed in automatic mode.

import.title: Import a product catalog
import.description: Upload your catalog from a CSV or Excel file.
steps: Go to Maintenance > Import / Export.
Prepare a file with at least Name, Purchase price and Selling price.
Choose CSV or Excel format.
Map columns if the headers differ.
Review the preview and confirm the import.
Existing products (same CIP or name) are updated automatically.

stock_alert.title: Handle a stock shortage
stock_alert.description: Identify at-risk products and place an order.
steps: Open Stock Analysis > Shortage.
Filter by supplier or day horizon.
Select the critical products to order.
Click Generate order.
Check the suggested quantities and confirm.
Track the order in Orders > Pending.

settings.title: Configure the pharmacy
settings.description: Fill in your pharmacy information and preferences.
steps: Go to Settings > Pharmacy.
Fill in name, address, phone and tax number.
Add your logo for printed documents.
In Settings > Printing, choose A4 or A5 format.
Save and test a receipt.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Speed up your daily workflow with ZENITH shortcuts.

troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting
troubleshooting.description: Solutions to the most common issues.

qz_connect.title: QZ Tray won't connect
steps: Check that QZ Tray is running (green icon near the clock).
Open the app with http://localhost (not a network IP).
If Kaspersky is installed, disable 'Inject script into web traffic'.
Press Ctrl+Shift+R to clear the PWA cache.
Check the F12 console that no CSP blocks ws://localhost:8182.

ticket_blurry.title: Receipt is blurry or text is cut off
steps: Use ESC/POS printing via QZ Tray (native text, not image).
In Settings > Printing, select the POS-80 printer.
Increase print density in the POS-80 driver preferences.
For A4 printing, choose A5 if the invoice has few lines.

license.title: License issue
steps: Check your Internet connection.
Go to Settings > License.
Enter the 6-character daily code provided by support.
If the issue persists, contact support with the exact error message.

printer_windows.title: Printer does not appear in Windows
steps: Check the USB cable and power supply.
Install the POS-80-Series driver.
Open Control Panel > Devices and Printers.
Print a Windows test page before testing in ZENITH.

offline.a: ZENITH needs a connection to the local or remote server to validate sales. If the connection drops, put sales on hold and validate them once it returns.

backup.q: How do I back up my data?
backup.a: A backup script is available: regularly back up the database and configuration files. Contact your system administrator to schedule backups.

update.a: Deployment is done via Docker. On the client server, run git pull then docker compose up -d. In development, use the deploy.ps1 script.

multi_poste.a: Yes. ZENITH is multi-workstation: each cashier opens ZENITH in their browser and shares the same database. Configure one printer per workstation in Settings > Printing.

thermal_labels.a: Yes, but it requires a TSPL/ZPL-compatible label printer (Xprinter, TSC, etc.). This feature will be enabled after ESC/POS receipt validation.

import.title: Product Database Import
import.description: ZENITH allows you to massively import your products from CSV or Excel (XLSX/XLS) files.

columns.title: File Columns
columns.required_details: You must provide at least the **Name** and one of the two **Prices** (Purchase or Sale).

logic.title: Import Logic
logic.tva: If VAT is not specified, it is calculated automatically: 0% if a public price exists, 19.25% if the public price is 0.
logic.update: If a product already exists (same CIP or same Name), it will be updated. Otherwise, it will be created.
logic.delimiter: The system automatically detects if you use semicolon (;) or comma (,) in your CSV files.

billing.title: Billing Management
billing.description: The billing module is designed for maximum productivity with the 'Zero Mouse' concept (Everything by keyboard).

qty_shortcut.title: Quick Quantity Shortcut
qty_shortcut.description: In the search bar, type '*' followed by a number (e.g., *5) to instantly change the quantity of the last added product.

navigation.title: Cart Navigation
navigation.description: Use arrow keys ↑↓ to select a line, '+' and '-' to adjust quantity, and 'Delete' to remove the item.

search.title: Smart Search
search.description: The system searches simultaneously by Name, CIP Code or Barcode. Scanning is automatic.

step1.title: Step 1: Open Sale
step1.description: Access the 'Billing' menu. The ZENITH interface is clean to allow you to focus on what matters.

step2.title: Step 2: Search for a Product
step2.description: Use the 'Product Search' field (F2). Type the name or scan directly. ZENITH displays stocks in real-time.

step3.title: Step 3: Manage Cart
step3.description: Once added, adjust quantities. The system automatically separates what the patient must pay.

tips.title: Tips
tips.score_intro: The score is automatically computed on <0>5 criteria</0>, each with a different weight:
tips.crit_fluidity: <0>Fluidity</0> — no dormant stock on active products
tips.crit_coverage: <0>Coverage</0> — stock between 15 and 90 days of sales
tips.crit_activity: <0>Activity</0> — products sold in the last 30 days
tips.crit_immobilization: <0>Immobilization</0> — little capital tied up in dead stock
tips.print_ink_tip: To save ink, use the <0>« PDF »</0> button rather than Ctrl+P. The PDF is generated in black and white without colored backgrounds.
tips.print_browser_tip: If printing from the browser: uncheck <0>« Background graphics »</0> in print options.
